messages:
lina-sales: Heads up - FinSolve demo just hit a wall. Their screen shows repeated 503s during a live walkthrough. Demo in 10min. Can someone jump in? :cold_sweat:
chris-support: On it. Which model/endpoint and are they streaming?
lina-sales: /v1/chat.stream, model=redwood-2-32k, single long prompt series but they opened ~20 simultaneous demo tabs.
sana-eng: 20 concurrent streams with large context can exhaust session capacity fast. Any error body?
lina-sales: Customer pasted this: 
```
{"status":503,"error":"CapacityThrottle","details":"backlog=34 queue_ms=2100 autoscale=provisioning_delayed"}
```
pete-infra: That backlog number is telling. Our autoscaler is provisioning but delay >2s so we route to 503 to avoid head-of-line impacts.
rhea-security: FinSolve also asked about whether Private & dedicated pools would avoid this during sales POC. I'll prep security Q answers but need a note on mitigations so they can present it.
chris-support: Short-term fixes: 1) reduce concurrent tabs (8-10) 2) use token-aware throttling or client-side concurrency cap 3) enable per-tenant burstpool bump for demo. Which can we flip now?
pete-infra: I can temporarily allocate +2 burst nodes to finSolve's burstpool for 20 minutes. That should absorb the spike. Doing a manual allocation now.
[90s later]
deploy-bot: action=allocate-burstpool tenant=finSolve nodes=2 initiated_by=pete-infra at 1940216834
pete-infra: Allocation applied. Monitoring... backlog fell 34 -> 4 and 503s stopped. We saw a small tail-latency bump (~80ms).
sana-eng: We should also enable a compatibility fallback to redwood-2-16k-quant for this tenant when backlog>15. It will reduce memory pressure and warm faster. Agree we need product signoff for visible fallback.
lina-sales: Customer on call prefers not to change model outputs mid-demo. They accepted reducing concurrency and we gave them a note about demo credits.
chris-support: I'll log a follow-up SR to dig into autoscaler cold-start timings and provisioning jitter: SR-8011. Also will include kernel selection logs for 32k variant warmup.
rhea-security: For the questionnaire: hosted has SOC2 + VPC options for Private deployments. I'll add a brief note that Dedicated/burstpool bump is a valid mitigation for demos but not guaranteed for production unless reserved.
sana-eng: Postmortem items: (a) add telemetry histogram of queue_ms during scale events, (b) tighten fallback trigger from backlog>20 to backlog>12 for high-sla tenants, (c) document recommended client retry policy (exp backoff starting 100ms, max 5 retries).
lina-sales: Thanks team. I'll share a single-slide workaround + timeline with FinSolve. Also capturing pricing ask: they want to know cost for a 30-min demo burst add-on. Can finance/sales calculate ad-hoc credits?
chris-support: I'll attach the incident log and live metrics snapshot to SR-8011. For now tell them estimate = 0.5x hourly dedicated node price * minutes used (send pricing calc to sales).
pete-infra: Filing infra follow-up: check if region had concurrent provisioning events at the same minute which could have slowed the cloud API. Ticket INF-4129.
lina-sales: On the call, they thanked us and resumed the demo after lowering tabs. All good for now. Please keep this thread updated with SR and INF links. :white_check_mark:
